summary: The first mismatch remains step 1742: C runs another monster movement sequence while JavaScript enters distress shapeshifting. The missing Hell-bat creation speed adjustment is a plausible cause, pending combined replay of its fix; the C actor is still unidentified. Accepted movement corrections preserve the score. The later refusal after 1757 screens now isolates the awake covetous-monster admission gate before dochug.

source.branch: C dochug calls distfleeck before and after m_move. The first divergent C suffix is distfleeck rn2(5), m_move rn2(3), m_lined_up rn2(25), m_move rn2(20), then distfleeck rn2(5). This is one movement sequence; the rn2(3) branch in m_move1869–1870 restricts the actor to a stalker, bat or light. JS has finished its scan and enters allmain elapsed-turn mcalcdistress, then mon.c decide_to_shapeshift for a fog cloud. Trace monster movement allocation/subtraction and scan continuation before changing either draw bound.
callers: allmain.c moveloop_core repeatedly calls movemon before distress, movement allocation and region upkeep. JS finishElapsedTurn and the projected monster scan must preserve that ordering and canonical per-monster movement state.

mon.c movemon_singlemon1214 and movemon1326 dispatch monmove.c dochug, which calls distfleeck around m_move. The later admission refusal identifies missing special-movement paths in m_move; that source port does not establish the earlier RNG cause.
dependencies: Accepted getpos.c collection/cycling now includes menu selection and cancellation, source coordinate descriptions and exact area-filter lifetime. Five independent recordings match. VIEW and other location-family entry recordings remain open in GOALS.json.

Its lookup coordinates differ from the encoded-prefix decode at (0,0); pet and hero overrides, Rogue colors and NOOVERRIDE order are verified. getpos_menu, displayed-glyph accessibility, cursor auto-description and clicked lookup recording entries remain open in GOALS.json.

Accepted invent.c look_here/dolook now handles tactile floor reach, arbitrary pile inspection, pile counts, cockatrice ordering and message filtering, with canonical force_decor and query_objlist callers. Three independent recordings cover movement menu/count and colon look. Swallowed inventory, blind ICE and the tactile-corpse fallback remain unrecorded entry families in GOALS.json; movement retains its mutation-free unsupported naming/pricing boundary.

Accepted allmain region upkeep runs supported callbacks after nh_timeout on cloned state during planning, preserving live output and shared-vision restoration. Harmful gas and unknown callbacks remain explicit boundaries; the region-fix goal remains parked pending its first-mismatch closure criterion.

Other unresolved source/coverage defects remain separate: make_stoned/minstapetrify/do_stone_mon; hero/monster stoning directions, corpse-weapon and attack-triggered golem entries; passive cold/fire/electricity/paralysis and lethal recovery; eating/non-food cleanup; skinback artifact-light radius and rare armor/Eyes-of-the-Overworld cleanup.

Liquid-specific entry recordings and exceptional partial rloc routes remain open; trap.c inventory-chain calls and mon.c deal_with_overcrowding remain named discarded-call gaps. GOALS.json preserves open print_dungeon, hitmu, mfind0, goto_level, minliquid, creation/flash, pickup and achievement entry families rather than treating supporting unit tests as their completion.

Hidden-attacker witnesses require eligible placement on objects or water, actual hidden state and an executed hitmu. Plain or qualified monster creation alone does not establish that entry; independent hidden-trapper and invisible-newt recordings establish creation/flash only.

Accepted m_move/mdisplacem corrections preserve canonical combat state, unicorn relocation returns and no-teleport predicates, movement dispatch order, and clone isolation for mimic reveals, stoning, worm tails and mail-daemon cleanup. Two independent permitted-Tengu relocation recordings and the combined checkpoint match. Displacement, mail, worm, covetous and exceptional dedicated-mover production entries remain open. The remaining special-movement refusal is the covetous admission gate in unported_monster_actions.js assertSimpleActionState, before dochug; trace wizard.c tactics and its preconditions next.

Accepted planning now reuses mon.c movemon and its safe snapshot iterator, callback termination and ordered cleanup. Deferred level transitions run live; planning resumes at the actual post-scan upkeep gate without an extra destination scan or hero ration debit. The first fixed mismatch remains1742, so this corrected dependency does not establish its cause.

Source-confirmed creation defect: makemon.c1343–1346 applies mon_adjust_speed(mtmp,2) when Inhell and is_bat(ptr); js/makemon_create.js omits that S_BAT branch. Hell bats therefore retain normal intrinsic speed in the port. C makes a vampire bat's base speed20 become27 before mcalcmove rounding, whereas the saved JS trace allocates12 to one candidate. This can explain missing extra actions, but the recorded C trace still does not establish the missing actor's identity. The canonical speed arithmetic and set_mon_data slowdown proration match the source; fix the creation caller and verify by replay.

evidence: Checkpoint 58583fcd preserves every fixed-session count and all 391 recordings, including two new Tengu relocation cases. Its scan still reports first screen/RNG mismatch 1742, cursor mismatch 1751 and special-movement refusal after 1757 emitted screens; the queue suffix upper bound remains 72.

Scratch-only trace run-hYPwnn at worker9971efc9 identifies JS RNGindex104705 in decide_to_shapeshift(mon.js3378), fog cloud PM106,m_id728,(16,18),mhp16/16,cham226. The corresponding C shapeshift draw occurs five positions later. These are diagnostic state values, not implementation constants.

JS preceding actor m_id492,PM129 moves(17,3) to(17,4) and completes its source-matched movement sequence. A second PM129,m_id491,starts at(46,19) with movement12, spends that ration in its own dochug and moves to(46,18); a later scan correctly sees movement0. Trace run-xJbhBi falsifies the claim that this candidate skipped its own action. C RNG annotations contain no actor identity, so the missing C actor and state cause remain unproved.

Both C and JS distfleeck begin with rn2(5); the JS rn2(4) is now traced to distress shapeshifting, not set_apparxy or track rejection. Two distfleeck calls around m_move describe one actor action, not two. Preserve this counter-evidence.

Next probe after the Hell-bat correction is measured: identify the missing movement actor and inspect its creation level, original makemon species, cham and speed state. C makemon.c applies the S_BAT speed adjustment only at creation in Hell; newcham/set_mon_data does not apply it when a vampire later takes bat form. Old shape traces include vampire bat forms with cham=PM_VAMPIRE but do not establish candidate 491 provenance. No post-A40 Knight replay artifact was found, so pre-A40 step-1742 evidence does not measure or falsify that correction.

Focused planner tests execute visible harmless vapor expiration through preflightSimpleMonsterActions on both success and later-refusal paths, pin setup RNG and verify clone/live vision isolation. The existing gas-spore recording establishes general elapsed-turn caller reachability only; no matching nonempty-region entry recording is claimed. Accepted scan138b1fd0 confirms the later RNG1742 boundary remains.
